<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><strong>An open-source framework for building AI investment research systems.</strong></p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">Hermes is the reusable Python framework a developer reaches for when building
professional AI investment-research applications. It ships pre-built
financial data tools, document ingestion pipelines, output generation
(Excel models, Word/PDF reports, charts), composable agents, and the
infrastructure you need to make those agents reliable, observable, and
extensible.</p>
<p dir="auto">Hermes does <strong>not</strong> answer <em>"what should I buy?"</em> — that question belongs to
your application, your strategy, and your judgment. What it answers:</p>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto"><em>"How do I give AI agents the tools, data, workflows, provenance, and
output infrastructure needed to perform serious investment research?"</em></p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">A downstream application can use Hermes as its research substrate without
modifying Hermes itself — registering custom agents, workflows, tools,
storage adapters, and event sinks.</p>
<hr>

<a href="#structured-outputs">Structured outputs</a>).</p>

<p dir="auto">All settings are accepted as kwargs to <code>configure()</code> or via environment
variables with the <code>HERMES_</code> prefix:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="from hermes import Hermes, configure

configure(
    llm_provider="anthropic",                  # or openai, google, ollama, ...
    llm_model="claude-sonnet-4-6",
    sec_user_agent="MyApp/1.0 (me@company.com)",
    fred_api_key="...",
    verbose=True,
)"><pre><span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">hermes</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">Hermes</span>, <span class="pl-s1">configure</span>

<span class="pl-en">configure</span>(
    <span class="pl-s1">llm_provider</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"anthropic"</span>,                  <span class="pl-c"># or openai, google, ollama, ...</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">llm_model</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"claude-sonnet-4-6"</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">sec_user_agent</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"MyApp/1.0 (me@company.com)"</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">fred_api_key</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"..."</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">verbose</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">True</span>,
)</pre></div>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">OpenAI-compatible endpoints (OpenRouter, vLLM, self-hosted)</h3><a id="user-content-openai-compatible-endpoints-openrouter-vllm-self-hosted" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: OpenAI-compatible endpoints (OpenRouter, vLLM, self-hosted)" href="#openai-compatible-endpoints-openrouter-vllm-self-hosted"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Hermes ships a generic <code>openai_compatible</code> provider and a preconfigured
<code>openrouter</code> convenience. Set the base URL and key via config:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="configure(
    llm_provider="openai_compatible",
    llm_model="my-model",
    llm_api_base="https://internal.example.com/v1",
    llm_api_key="...",
    llm_context_window=32000,                # optional
    llm_is_function_calling_model=True,      # optional
)"><pre><span class="pl-en">configure</span>(
    <span class="pl-s1">llm_provider</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"openai_compatible"</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">llm_model</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"my-model"</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">llm_api_base</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"https://internal.example.com/v1"</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">llm_api_key</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"..."</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">llm_context_window</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">32000</span>,                <span class="pl-c"># optional</span>
    <span class="pl-s1">llm_is_function_calling_model</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-c1">True</span>,      <span class="pl-c"># optional</span>
)</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">Or for OpenRouter:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="configure(
    llm_provider="openrouter",
    llm_model="anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5",
    llm_api_key="...",                        # OpenRouter API key
)"><pre><span class="pl-en">configure</span>(
    <span class="pl-s1">llm_provider</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"openrouter"</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">llm_model</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5"</span>,
    <span class="pl-s1">llm_api_key</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"..."</span>,                        <span class="pl-c"># OpenRouter API key</span>
)</pre></div>
<p dir="auto">See <a href="/schnetzlerjoe/hermes/blob/main/examples/openrouter.py"><code>examples/openrouter.py</code></a>.</p>
<p dir="auto">Add your own providers at runtime:</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="from hermes.llm_providers import ProviderSpec, register_provider

register_provider(
    ProviderSpec(
        name="my_internal",
        import_module="llama_index.llms.openai_like",
        class_name="OpenAILike",
        extra_kwargs={"api_base": "https://internal.example/v1"},
    )
)"><pre><span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">hermes</span>.<span class="pl-s1">llm_providers</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">ProviderSpec</span>, <span class="pl-s1">register_provider</span>

<span class="pl-en">register_provider</span>(
    <span class="pl-en">ProviderSpec</span>(
        <span class="pl-s1">name</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"my_internal"</span>,
        <span class="pl-s1">import_module</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"llama_index.llms.openai_like"</span>,
        <span class="pl-s1">class_name</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span><span class="pl-s">"OpenAILike"</span>,
        <span class="pl-s1">extra_kwargs</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span>{<span class="pl-s">"api_base"</span>: <span class="pl-s">"https://internal.example/v1"</span>},
    )
)</pre></div>

<p dir="auto">A workflow composes a root agent with a set of specialists and decides

<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="from hermes import Hermes

)

result = await h.run("Research NVDA", workflow=workflow)"><pre><span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">hermes</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">Hermes</span>

<p dir="auto"><code>run_structured()</code> returns a <code>ResearchResult</code> with a full <code>ResearchRun</code>
record: participating agents, provider/model, status, timestamps,
sources, and artifacts. Failures don't raise — they return
<code>ResearchResult</code> with <code>run.status = failed</code> and <code>run.error</code> set.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="result = await h.run_structured("Research AMBA")

<span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s1">result</span>.<span class="pl-c1">response</span>)
<span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s1">result</span>.<span class="pl-c1">run</span>.<span class="pl-c1">agents</span>)
<span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s1">result</span>.<span class="pl-c1">run</span>.<span class="pl-c1">sources</span>)</pre></div>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Event sinks</h3><a id="user-content-event-sinks" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Event sinks" href="#event-sinks"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><code>Hermes(event_sinks=[...])</code> fans every event (workflow started,
agent output, tool call, artifact created, …) out to every callable
sink. Async sinks are scheduled; sync sinks block. Sink exceptions are
logged but don't abort the run.</p>
<div class="highlight highlight-source-python notranslate position-relative overflow-auto" dir="auto" data-snippet-clipboard-copy-content="def my_sink(event):
    print(f"[{event.run_id}] {event.type}: {event.text or event.metadata}")

h = Hermes(event_sinks=[my_sink])"><pre><span class="pl-k">def</span> <span class="pl-en">my_sink</span>(<span class="pl-s1">event</span>):
    <span class="pl-en">print</span>(<span class="pl-s">f"[<span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">{</span><span class="pl-s1">event</span>.<span class="pl-c1">run_id</span><span class="pl-kos">}</span></span>] <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">{</span><span class="pl-s1">event</span>.<span class="pl-c1">type</span><span class="pl-kos">}</span></span>: <span class="pl-s1"><span class="pl-kos">{</span><span class="pl-s1">event</span>.<span class="pl-c1">text</span> <span class="pl-c1">or</span> <span class="pl-s1">event</span>.<span class="pl-c1">metadata</span><span class="pl-kos">}</span></span>"</span>)

<span class="pl-s1">h</span> <span class="pl-c1">=</span> <span class="pl-en">Hermes</span>(<span class="pl-s1">event_sinks</span><span class="pl-c1">=</span>[<span class="pl-s1">my_sink</span>])</pre></div>

h = Hermes(research_store=LocalResearchStore("~/.hermes/runs"))"><pre><span class="pl-k">from</span> <span class="pl-s1">hermes</span> <span class="pl-k">import</span> <span class="pl-v">Hermes</span>
